data.rationale: The proposal follows the same steps in the same order: select the city, open Special Events & Experiences, open the event, set the ticket count, click Book Now or a time slot, then Reserve Now. However, it never names {date} as a parameter. Instead it picks the event by {event_name}, which only covers the date because the event titles happen to include it, and it adds an extra ticket_type_or_time parameter. The spec is still concrete enough to automate.
